entities.name: Ghave
entities.description: Mycoid heroic shaman, Guru of Spores, who led the fungus and saprolings against the humans of Drakkus.

entities.name: Mycoids
entities.description: Fungal people who declared war on the invading humans.

entities.name: Drakkus
entities.description: Humans forced into the fungal forests after monsoons devastated their land.

events.summary: Monsoons devastated the humans' land, forcing them into the fungal forests, where they preyed on mycoids and saprolings; the mycoids declared war.
events.quote: the mycoids saw them as genocide, declaring war against the invaders.

events.summary: Ghave arrived and turned the tide, sculpting an ever-mutating fungal army and reclaiming his forest home.
events.quote: Only with the arrival of Ghave did the tide turn.

relations.note: War against the humans of Drakkus.
relations.quote: in the war against the humans of Drakkus

relations.note: Heroic shaman of the fungus and saproling.
relations.quote: is the mycoid heroic shaman of the fungus and saproling
